# Maaot cave environments

Downloaded on 2026-08-29 from the creator's itch.io pages:

- [2D DarkCave Assets](https://maaot.itch.io/2d-browncave-assets)
- [Mossy Cavern](https://maaot.itch.io/mossy-cavern)

Creator: Maaot.

Mossy Cavern license V0.1 permits use in free and commercial projects and
modification. Credit is optional. The assets may not be repackaged,
redistributed, or resold, regardless of modification.

The DarkCave page and the creator's answers on that page permit commercial game
use. The pack does not contain grid tiles; it contains large rocks, platforms,
floor and wall compositions, background pieces, and decorations. The importer
adapts selected pieces to the game's terrain interface.

The source archives and generated runtime slices are intentionally ignored by
Git to avoid turning this repository into an asset redistribution channel. Put
the downloaded archives here as `dark-cave.zip` and `mossy-cavern.zip`, then run
`python tools/ArtPipeline/build_runtime_assets.py`.
